zh_summary: @JavierBlas column: BP should resist calls to resume buybacks now and use the oil and gas windfall to fix its debt problem for good.

text:
COLUMN: BP should resist calls to resume share buybacks immediately -- and instead use today's oil and gas windfall to fix its debt problem once and for all.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: $TSM is exploring a Texas expansion and in discussions with Elon Musk about Terafab as $SPCX and $TSLA scale ambitions across AI, robotics & chipmaking. Musk could own the facility while TSMC operates the fab inside it, potentially lowering costs and bringing advanced production closer.
en_summary: $TSM is exploring a Texas expansion and in discussions with Elon Musk about Terafab as $SPCX and $TSLA scale ambitions across AI, robotics & chipmaking. Musk could own the facility while TSMC operates the fab inside it, potentially lowering costs and bringing advanced production closer.
text:
$TSM is exploring a Texas expansion and is in discussions with Elon Musk about Terafab as $SPCX and $TSLA scale their ambitions across AI, robotics & chipmaking.

What’s really interesting is that Musk could own the facility while TSMC operates the fab inside it potentially lowering expansion costs while bringing advanced chip production closer to both companies.

text:
$TSM released earnings today. I was more curious about commentary given recent the market panic.

For analyst Q&A rounds: 

Q: Citi explicitly challenged TSMC on AI financing, HBM, CoWoS, lasers and the risk of overbuilding capacity 

A: $TSM assessed CSP capex, DC construction conditions, customer financial conditions, and supply of critical components. 

Management's conclusion is still that "demand exceeds supply". As well as that AI accelerator revenue growth could exceed its previous 50%+ CAGR projection through 2029.

This is a more meaningful statement since it addresses some concerns regarding recent selloff. 

Q: JPM asked if wafer supply could be tighter in 2027 than in 2026 (demand visibility)

A: Wei (Chairman/CEO) stated $TSM even sends staff to verify DC construction progress on site. And after assessing all the factors, TSMC believes gap between supply and demand remains substantial.  

It could not determine whether the extent of the gap given customers continues to increase demand. 

Q: On pricing power:

A: Wei responded that there is "no ceiling on TSMC's profitability" but that profits will not surge dramatically overnight.

(Source: NextApple, Taiwanese press)

Regarding earnings, very strong: as usual 

- TSMC record profits of $23.6B (68% Y/Y growth), and revenue jumping to $46.72B, beating expectations.

- Q4 Guidance was $52.3-$54.3B revenue off 65-67% gross margins.

TLDR:

- No signs of any slowdown or collapse as AI demand far exceeds supply for fo
